criteria.criterion: Prepared/mounted CodingRuntime explicit cross-provider whole invocation
criteria.evidence: CodingRuntime::start, actual parent stream task ToolCall, runtime-mounted tool, actual child loop, selected Gemini factory/provider calls and output cap, child cannot mount recursive task, unknown-ID zero builds/child calls, parent Responses model/key/sampling invariants, successful reload and failed parent reassembly preserving selected generation. Session-disabled factory session explicitly asserted None. Original cloned registry remains immutable after reload.
criteria.remaining: Nonempty persisted-session binding and running/queued bindings across reload are not combined in this runtime test; the preserved factory running/queued test covers immutable bindings with old/new nonempty session IDs separately. No inaccessible-seam claim is made.

criteria.criterion: Parent conversation and legacy/native snapshot invariance
criteria.evidence: Real runtime serialized SessionSnapshot preexisting messages remain exactly equal as a prefix after explicit success, unknown-ID rejection, terminal child provider failure, successful/failed reload and blocked child cancellation. Snapshot top-level schema keys unchanged. Expected new parent user/tool/result/assistant additions are outside the compared prefix. Synthetic parent/task credentials absent from serialized snapshots.
criteria.remaining: SessionMode::Disabled snapshots exercise native runtime memory/serialization, not persisted SessionManager files or legacy snapshot serialization/omitted-ID comparison. Those persistence compatibility portions remain open; this report does not declare all three reviewer criteria fully closed.

criteria.evidence: DefaultCodingProviderFactory real adapters resolved from registry for openai, responses, claude, gemini and ollama. Loopback-only HTTP recorder captures protocol endpoint, API model (Gemini URL), per-task synthetic authentication and output caps; reasoning/thinking bodies checked. Provider context_window asserted 32000 (local policy, not necessarily wire field), bound max_tokens 1234 and reasoning high checked. criteria.remaining: Not an exhaustive matrix of all reasoning/vision/TLS/signing permutations; does not establish remote serving identity.
